queries.query_text: Find semiconductor and VLSI design experts at Indian institutions. Show their current projects and chip fabrication capabilities.

synthesis.recommendation: 35 semiconductor experts across India. IIT Hyderabad leads with TSMV/Intel foundry partnerships. 7nm chip design capability available.

queries.query_text: What is the cybersecurity research ecosystem in India? Find experts in cryptography, network security, and threat detection.

synthesis.recommendation: 42 cybersecurity experts. Cryptography and blockchain dominate. Dr. Sunita Sharma (IIT Delhi) leads with 8 industry collaborations. Average TRL 4-5.

queries.query_text: Find quantum computing research teams available for industry partnerships. Show their current focus, technology maturity, and collaboration terms.

synthesis.recommendation: 25 quantum research teams. IITGN leads with superconducting qubit development (99.2% gate fidelity). Industry partnership possible with ₹15 Cr contribution for joint IP.

queries.query_text: Map the agricultural technology ecosystem in India. Find experts in precision farming, IoT sensors, and drone technology for agriculture.

synthesis.recommendation: 56 agri-tech experts. Precision farming leads with 23 experts. IIT Ropar has strongest ecosystem with 8 industry collaborations. Drone tech growing at 45% annually.

queries.query_text: Find materials science researchers working on graphene applications. Show their current projects, patent portfolio, and commercialization readiness.

synthesis.recommendation: 18 graphene researchers. Dr. Anita Kumar (IITGN) leads with 5 patents and TRL 6 commercialization readiness. Average project size ₹18 Cr.

queries.query_text: Show the automotive R&D ecosystem in India. Find researchers working on EV technology, autonomous vehicles, and battery management systems.

synthesis.recommendation: 67 automotive R&D experts. EV Battery Systems leads with 28 experts. IIT Bombay has strongest ecosystem. 45 active industry projects worth ₹890 Cr.

queries.query_text: Find healthcare AI researchers with experience in medical imaging, diagnostics, and clinical AI. Show their technology readiness for deployment.

synthesis.recommendation: 45 healthcare AI researchers. Dr. Priya Patel (IITGN) has TRL 8 deployment with FDA clearance in progress. 5 medical imaging products already deployed.

queries.query_text: Map the robotics research ecosystem in India. Find experts in industrial robotics, autonomous navigation, and human-robot interaction.

synthesis.recommendation: 52 robotics experts. Industrial robotics leads. IIT Madras has ₹65 Cr robotics infrastructure. 45 active industry collaborations worth ₹567 Cr.

queries.query_text: Find researchers working on 5G/6G communication technologies. Show their focus areas, test infrastructure, and industry collaboration history.

synthesis.recommendation: 38 telecom researchers. 6G research growing at 65% annually. IIT Hyderabad has ₹45 Cr test infrastructure. Industry partnerships include major telecom operators.

queries.query_text: Find cleantech researchers working on carbon capture, waste-to-energy, and environmental remediation. Show their technology readiness for scale-up.

synthesis.recommendation: 34 cleantech researchers. Waste-to-energy has highest TRL (7) and scale-up readiness. 18 environmental remediation experts with industry partnerships worth ₹234 Cr.

queries.query_text: Map the data science and analytics capabilities across Indian IITs. Find experts in big data, predictive analytics, and business intelligence.

synthesis.recommendation: 78 data science experts. Machine learning dominates with 45 experts and 32 industry projects. IIT Bombay leads with ₹567 Cr in analytics projects.
